intro: Hold the question quietly in mind, then shake the tube.
drawn: Toss the moon blocks to ask if this is your lot.
rules: Up to three tosses. Yes (one up, one down): read your lot. Ask again (both up): say your question more clearly and toss again. Not yet (both down): the time isn't right — pause, then toss again. Three "not yet" in a row means it's time to ask something else.

sheng.name: Yes
sheng.text: The answer is yes — this lot is yours.

xiao.name: Ask again
xiao.text: It isn't clear yet. Put your question a little more plainly and toss again.

yin.name: Not yet
yin.text: A sign the time isn't right. Take a breath, then toss again.

reask: Three "not yet" in a row — this isn't the moment for that question. Ask something else and draw a new lot.
give_up: No "yes" in three tosses. Let it rest for today and come back tomorrow.
rounds_out: You've rephrased a few times today. Set it down for now and come back tomorrow.
